messages.subject: Tokyo data set not giving me the same results shown in the manual
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to repeat the Tokyo example (with model "RW2") exactly as shown in the manual. It works, but instead of 

Random effects:

                   Fixed PostMean PostSD

time : prec FALSE 11196.92 6064.60


I am getting PostMean 13308.68, SD  8953.24.

Has anyone seen those values before? The formula I'm using is

> formula

y ~ f(time, model = "rw2", cyclic = TRUE, param = c(1, 1e-04)) - 1


and the call is

result = inla(formula, family="binomial", Ntrials=n, data=Tokyo, control.inla=list(strategy='laplace'))


I don't see what's different, and I'm wondering if something has changed in the more recent version.
